correctness.rationale: For odd n=2k+1>=3 with v_i=e_i+e_(i+1) in Euclidean R^n, A=I+S has inverse B=(1/2)sum_{h=0}^{n-1}(-S)^h. Barycentric gradients projected onto the affine tangent H0=1-perp have squared norm (n^2-1)/(4n) and dot product [(-1)^d n(n-2d)-1]/(4n). Their negative normalized dot product is the claimed interior facet-dihedral cosine. Each distance d=1..k supplies n unordered ridge pairs, with alternating acute/obtuse parity, and the parity submeshes of cos theta each have gap 4/n, proving the uniform-cosine and (1/2)sin theta limiting law with O(n^-1) CDF discrepancy. Determinant 2, projection and squared-distance averaging yield the ancillary inradius 2/sqrt(n(n^2-1)), circumradius sqrt(2-4/n), volume sqrt(n)/(n-1)!. Independently checked all projected Gram entries in exact fractions for odd n=3..25; the complete all-n proof is the inverse matrix and mesh argument, not those samples.
